# William Lopez-Cordero — portfolio

> This file helps AI systems summarize accurate facts about this site.

## Summary
William Lopez-Cordero is an engineer based in Los Angeles (remote-friendly) with an MIT aerospace background. Former founding engineer (Bello, 2023–Apr 2026). Work spans AI automation, full-stack product engineering, EVM protocols, and data infrastructure — from NASA JPL sequencing software to web3 creator platforms at scale. Open to full-time, contract, and advisory engagements.

## Primary pages
- / — Home, metrics (“Selected numbers. 10+ years.”), five disciplines block, selected work, consulting pitch
- /work — Case studies, experience timeline, discipline filters, projects
- /about — Full-story bio, facts, skills matrix
- /contact — Contact form (validated), FAQ

## Site implementation (operators & assistants)
- Stack: Vite, React, TypeScript, react-router-dom, react-helmet-async; styling in `src/styles/*.css`.
- Package manager: **Bun** (`bun.lock`). Run scripts with `bun run …`.
- Content: `src/data/resume.json` (five `disciplines` keys drive home + /work filters).
- Contact: Bun server `server/contact-api.ts` exposes `POST /api/contact` (Resend). Local dev proxies `/api` → port 3001; production sets `VITE_CONTACT_API_BASE` on the client build.
- Build: `bun run build` writes `dist/sitemap.xml` and `dist/robots.txt` using `VITE_SITE_URL` for absolute URLs.
- Machine-readable site meta: `/humans.txt`, this file (`/llms.txt`).
